description: IEA EBC Annex 71, Building Energy Performance Assessment Based on In-situ Measurements, ran from 2016 to 2021 to improve how the actual energy performance of buildings is predicted, characterised and quality assured using on-board monitoring combined with dynamic data analysis. It focused on residential buildings, at the level of individual occupied dwellings controlled by their own services and at aggregated levels such as apartment buildings, neighbourhoods and districts, and aimed to disaggregate energy use into building fabric, systems and users. Deliverables listed include dynamic datasets at building and district scale for developing analysis procedures and for validation, and reports on input data reliability, dynamic data analysis methods, building and district case studies and guidelines. Coverage: residential case studies in participating countries. Access: the IEA EBC project page and the Annex website hosted by KU Leuven. Licence: IEA EBC publication terms; free. Caveats: dataset availability and formats vary by case, and the Annex website was not read here. Simulation uses are validating dynamic building models and in-situ characterisation methods such as heat loss coefficient estimation. Related records: the IEA EBC Annex 58 twin houses validation data and ASHRAE Standard 140.
